recommendation: Keep the source-fix commit as-is. Do not use this reconciliation to close FHIR-54459; any additional dataAbsentReason or v2-FHIR mapping guidance should be handled by a final work-group decision on that separate issue or in the v2-FHIR mapping source.
issue_request: FHIR-46579 asked how to represent HL7 v2 OBX-11 "cannot be obtained" when it did not map cleanly to Observation.status. Although the Jira metadata is Applied/Persuasive, the final comments and OO minutes say the prior Observation.status/dataAbsentReason update was dropped and the issue was applied to v2-FHIR mapping guidance instead: map OBX-11=X to Observation.status=cancelled with the original/alternate value extension on Observation.status.
initial_application: Commit ae3460e91f30bdfd55e6aa6805552527db820ee0 applied the superseded direction by adding cannot-be-obtained to source/observation/codesystem-observation-status.xml, source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml, and source/observation/observation-event-mapping-exceptions.xml. The later Jira comments explicitly state that update was to the wrong code system, no Observation.status or Observation.dataAbsentReason update was needed, and the core update could be dropped.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the edited Observation StructureDefinition and companion Observation source files are in current build scope. The 2024-10-04 OO minutes corroborate the reopened decision and explain that "cannot be obtained" is too broad. Later FHIR-50536 updated the Observation.status v2 mapping text in commit e0109df825a; that later mapping guidance was left untouched. FHIR-54459 is a later Triaged, unresolved issue questioning the same stale status value, so it was treated as background only.
reconciliation: Removed cannot-be-obtained from the active Observation status code system, the Observation.status short value, and the Event mapping exception value. No v2 mapping prose was changed because the later FHIR-50536 mapping text is an independent applied decision and is consistent with using an extension rather than a new core Observation.status code.
